class.name: CgameSpatialQuery
class.brief_description: EQS-style spatial query graph: generators, tests (filters and scorers) and ranked items.
class.description: Native port of the Cgame GDScript spatial query graph. The asset is a plain, serialisable [Dictionary]; [Callable]s are supplied through the context. Naming follows Unreal's Environment Query System and the engine's [code]EnvironmentQuery3D[/code]: result entries use the same [code]position[/code], [code]index[/code] and [code]score[/code] keys, ordering is descending score with the source index breaking ties, and [method get_candidates] exports the generated positions so an [code]EnvironmentQuery3D[/code] can score the same candidate set. Response curves come from [CgameUtilityAI]. [b]Asset:[/b] [code]{name, generators: [..], tests: [..], combine: "weighted" | "iaus", max_results, min_score}[/code]. Use [method new_asset], [method make_generator], [method make_test], [method add_generator] and [method add_test] to build one. [b]Generators:[/b] [code]grid {half_extents, spacing}[/code], [code]ring {radius, count}[/code], [code]navmesh {radius, count}[/code] and [code]actors {actor_type, radius}[/code]. At most [constant MAX_ITEMS] items are generated. [b]Tests:[/b] [code]{type: distance | dot | trace | path_length | custom, name, weight, min, max, invert, curve, slope, shift, score, filter_min, filter_max, to: querier | target, axis: facing | to_target, callable}[/code]. A test normalises its raw value from [code][min, max][/code] to [code][0, 1][/code], optionally inverts it and shapes it with a [enum CgameUtilityAI.Response] curve. Items whose raw value falls outside [code]filter_min[/code] / [code]filter_max[/code] are discarded; tests with [code]score: false[/code] only filter. [b]Context:[/b] [code]{querier: Vector3, facing: Vector3, target: Vector3, navmesh_points: Callable(center, radius, count) -> Array[Vector3], actors: [{position, type, id}], trace: Callable(from, to) -> bool (true = clear), path_length: Callable(from, to) -> float (negative = unreachable), custom: {name: Callable(position, context, item) -> float}}[/code]. Queries can be time-sliced: call [method start], then [method step] once per frame until it returns [code]true[/code]; the result equals a full [method run].

method.name: add_generator
method.description: Appends [param generator] to [param asset] and returns its index.

method.name: add_test
method.description: Appends [param test] to [param asset] and returns its index.

method.name: debug
method.description: Returns debug information: [code]{name, generated, generators: [{type, count}], evaluated, passed, steps, filtered_by: {test: n}, tests: {name: {evaluated, filtered, min, max, mean}}}[/code]. [code]steps[/code] and [code]tests[/code] are filled once the query has finished. Empty before the first [method start].

method.name: get_candidates
method.description: Returns the positions of all generated items in generation order (indexable with the [code]index[/code] of a result).

method.name: is_done
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when no query is in flight (or none was started).

method.name: make_generator
method.description: Creates a generator [Dictionary] of [param type] ([code]grid[/code], [code]ring[/code], [code]navmesh[/code] or [code]actors[/code]) with default parameters, overridden by [param params].

method.name: make_test
method.description: Creates a test [Dictionary] of [param type] ([code]distance[/code], [code]dot[/code], [code]trace[/code], [code]path_length[/code] or [code]custom[/code]) with default parameters, overridden by [param params]. Unnamed tests are named [code]"<type>_<index>"[/code] when the query starts.

method.name: progress
method.description: Returns the fraction of generated items that have been evaluated, in [code][0, 1][/code].

method.name: results
method.description: Returns the ranked results of the last finished query: dictionaries with [code]position[/code], [code]index[/code], [code]score[/code], [code]passed[/code], [code]tests[/code] (per test [code]raw[/code] and [code]score[/code]) and, for actor items, [code]actor[/code].

method.name: run
method.description: Runs the whole query synchronously and returns the ranked [method results].

method.name: start
method.description: Generates all items (cheap) and prepares the tests for time-sliced evaluation. Returns the number of generated items.

method.name: step
method.description: Evaluates up to [param budget_items] items (at least one). Returns [code]true[/code] once the query has finished.

method.name: validate
method.description: Returns error strings for an asset without generators, unknown generator or test types, and scoring tests whose [code]max[/code] is not greater than [code]min[/code]. An empty array means the asset is valid.

constants.constant: Maximum number of generated items; further items are dropped.
